remarks: In the heart of Cos Cob, walk to train, downtown village, coffee shops, restaurants and more. The home is 3,207. sqr. ft with an open floorplan in the kitchen/dining/living room area. The Master Bedroom is on the main level another two bedrooms on the 3rd floor, and a large fourth bedroom or office on the 1st floor. Oak hardwood flooring throughout the home. The custom kitchen has Thermador appliances, Gas range and a wine fridge. The Home boasts Cat6 wiring, and separate laundry room with large washer/dryer. Attached 2-car car garage and small backyard area that is perfect for relaxing, grilling, and small games like corn-hole or latterball toss. Landlord handles all outside grounds., Snow management, and trash.
